title: Levenshtein edit distance
prompt: Implement `edit_distance(a, b)` classic Levenshtein distance (insert/delete/substitute cost 1).
test_source:
import solution

def run():
    assert solution.edit_distance('a','a')==0
    assert solution.edit_distance('kitten','sitting')==3
    assert solution.edit_distance('','abc')==3
